result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, pays no early-termination charge, and Vendor receives no convenience-termination right. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” adds a partial-scope termination right not required by the playbook and could disrupt pricing or service-bundle economics. The refund language also does not clearly allocate prepaid fees when only part of an Order Form is terminated.
